card.name: Small words before dose after adjust verbs
card.fires_on: The word 'the' (also 'this' or 'starting') right after a verb of changing a dose, such as reduce, lower, increase or consider reducing. It appears in drug interaction and dosing sections, just before 'dose' or 'dosage'.

modes.label: the after adjust verb
modes.description: 'the' directly follows reduce, lower or increase and comes just before a dose word.
modes.example: Intervention Consider reducing<< the>> dose of Venlafaxine Extended

modes.label: starting or this before dose
modes.description: 'Starting' or 'this' stands in the slot before a dose noun in a dosing statement.
modes.example: Some patients may respond to the<< starting>> dosage.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the next word to be a dose term such as dose or dosage, and to push away measurement and concentration words.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after 'reduce' or 'increase' that comes right before 'the dose'.
